##### Project general facts

Peace Avenue is a contemporary residential development located in the strategically positioned Jebel Ali district, offering a refined urban lifestyle shaped by connectivity and future growth. Designed to align with Dubai’s westward expansion, the project combines elegant architecture with a calm residential atmosphere, creating a balanced environment for modern city living. Its proximity to major transport routes, metro access, and key economic hubs places residents within easy reach of Dubai’s most important destinations while remaining part of an emerging community.

The project is conceived as a lifestyle-focused address, where residential comfort meets thoughtfully planned communal spaces. With a strong emphasis on wellness, privacy, and everyday convenience, Peace Avenue is designed to cater to professionals, end-users, and long-term residents seeking a contemporary home in a high-potential location. The building integrates retail and social elements at podium and ground levels, reinforcing a sense of community and active living.

Interiors at Peace Avenue feature modern finishes with a warm, neutral palette, complemented by high-quality flooring, refined wall treatments, and floor-to-ceiling glazing that enhances natural light. Kitchens are fully fitted with contemporary cabinetry, stone countertops, and integrated appliances from recognized international brands, ensuring both functionality and visual coherence. Residences are delivered fully furnished with carefully selected furniture, lighting, and soft finishes, creating move-in-ready homes that reflect a cohesive and elegant design language.
 
##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world’s largest container hubs, which has cemented the area’s global significance in trade and commerce.

Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents.

The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.
